declaration_timing: Assumed g factor chosen from sensor-only evidence before external model error results; do not tune the scale from target HR outcomes.

source_evidence.finding: The released GalaxyPPG ACC CSV axes have already been converted to m/s^2 using 9.81/(16383.75/4.0)*value. Keep source CSV values unchanged.

external_evidence.finding: The accelerometer is an STMicroelectronics LIS2DH acquired at 200 Hz; released synchronized sensor streams are 128 Hz. The inspected datasheet, file-structure guide, README, and native trace descriptions do not state a numerical unit for MAT v fields.

The published motion analysis labels its axis accelerometer magnitude (g), with most observations near one g. This supports the g assumption and agrees with native MAT values; the figure alone does not explicitly document the numeric scaling of the released MAT v fields.
The observed near-one gravity magnitude is consistent with g. This is an empirical plausibility check, not documentary verification of units or calibration.

conversion_policy: Diagnostic only: multiply preserved native WildPPG ACC once by 9.80665 under an explicitly unverified g assumption. Preserve the native signals. Do not describe resulting motion-aware scores as fully unit-verified external transfer.
remaining_evidence_needed: Author-provided numeric unit definition or original firmware/export conversion code linking the released MAT acceleration values to g or SI. The LIS2DH model alone cannot establish configured sensitivity or export scaling.
unit_independent_outputs: Individual PPG-only experts and gates proven to use no ACC-dependent feature may be reported separately with the corresponding inference feature audit; this contract does not by itself prove a gate is ACC-independent.
